calls.video_title: The Entire Market Relies On These Stocks
calls.thesis: HOLD reiterated: remaining fully invested and holding into Wednesday earnings despite 33x forward P/E and very high expectations (revenue +50-55%, EPS ~+89% expected); sees a true monopoly whose moat widens over the next decade, with installed-base management potentially tripling to $25-30B.
calls.bull_case: High-NA EUV lead widens; every chip still has to go through ASML's machines; supplier/customer/logistics moats deepen.
calls.bear_case: Expectations are extreme this quarter; a miss would hurt the stock badly and the market has sold ASML down incorrectly before.

calls.video_title: How I'm Investing With $1.5 Million Stock Portfolio
calls.thesis: Continuing to hold despite higher valuation — China sales mix fell from ~50% to ~14%, derisking; install-base management is reliable recurring revenue.
